profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer
profile.summary: An exceptionally driven software engineer with over five years of experience specializing in security. Developed a wide range of tools to establish a default state of strong data security while optimizing efficiency.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description: Responsible for designing, building, and maintaining cryptographic key management functionality within the Key Management Framework (KMF) in ServiceNow. This includes implementing secure key lifecycle operations (generation, exchange, rotation, revocation) aligned with NIST 800-57 standards.

positions.title: Lead Member of Technical Staff
positions.description:
- Built a framework that restricted all Salesforce UI controllers from accessing data beyond their access rights.
- Designed & Architected a new CSP violation report micro service to process violation reports.
- Developed a WASM filter to inject any missing security headers.
- Enabled the ability to allow customers to inject cross origin headers to their custom pages.
- Protected Salesforce core ecosystem by analyzing & providing solutions to OWASP top 10 security risks.

positions.title: Senior Member of Technical Staff
positions.description:
- Worked with various security engineers and data scientists to develop automatic restriction of malicious actor's access rights based on a risk score.
- Defense APIs were enhanced to be able to tag and suppress existing sessions. 
- Additional Defense framework was developed to detect malicious actors quickly and efficiently.

positions.title: Member of Technical Staff
positions.description:
- Continued to expand encryption capability on fields that were previously unsupported. 
- Joined a new team to build a session-based defense mechanism that can defend malicious actors from causing harm.
- The product was further honed to be able to track malicious actors' activity upon successful detection.

positions.title: Associate Member of Technical Staff
positions.description:
- Maintained and enhanced existing and new core API.
- Built encryption at rest (now known as part of Salesforce shield) on the Salesforce platform.
- Enhanced the encryption service to allow customers to bring their own encryption keys to encrypt data.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer (Intern)
positions.description:
•  Built a web tool that checks metadata of upcoming Amazon digital products using Google Web Toolkit.
•  Created the design plan and made the fully working project from the ground up within 12 weeks.
•  Successfully connected existing backend services using spring framework to strengthen robustness.

positions.title: Technical Consultant (Intern)
positions.description:
•  Developed, validated, and supported code releases using ABAP
•  Led and managed the mobile project by communicating with other developers and building the backend system
•  Interacted with global colleagues to collaborate and develop enhancements for the SAP Partner Relationship Management (PRM) system
•  Performed robustness testing on PRM Rebates using various test methods.

positions.title: Quality Assurance Engineer (Intern)
positions.description:
•  Wrote test automation scenarios for prototypes using Rational Functional Tester
•  Investigated regular expression work around for the test automation
•  Performed Functional Verification Testing (FVT) on IBM prototypes

positions.title: Global Proposition Software Engineer (Intern)
positions.description:
•  Built HSBC commercial banking prototypes for business analysts
•  Created business requirements for the HSBC Global Trade system 
•  Communicated with other developers and business analysts located in Hong Kong and India     to satisfy stringent requirements

volunteerExperiences.description:
• Fundraised for donation by organizing concerts and selling bracelets
• Promoted cancer awareness to other people by putting posters at public places
• Distributed necessities such as food to Vancouver’s homeless people
